name: How long does a hidden mold detection inspection take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a hidden mold detection inspection take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a hidden mold detection inspection typically depends on the size and accessibility of the property, as well as the suspected extent of the mold issue. A standard inspection for a residential home might take anywhere from 1 to 3 hours. More complex cases, such as those involving multiple areas of concern, extensive water damage, or larger commercial properties, could require several hours or even a full day. Our technicians work efficiently while ensuring a thorough investigation to accurately identify any hidden mold.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical hidden mold inspection takes 1 to 3 hours, but complex or larger properties may require more time for thorough investigation.
